name: mobile-design-template
description: Mobile Template Design System: Figma tokens and components as a React library, documented in Storybook.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build -w @garethkikilund-commits/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:tokens && npm run typecheck -w @garethkikilund-commits/ui
scripts.storybook: npm run build:tokens && npm run storybook -w @garethkikilund-commits/ui
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build:tokens && npm run build-storybook -w @garethkikilund-commits/ui
